sentences.en: One of the largest outbreaks of the coronavirus in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国最大的新冠病毒疫情爆发点之一，

sentences.en: has been inside a meat processing plant in South Dakota.
sentences.zh: 出现在南达科他州的一家肉类加工厂内。

sentences.en: My colleague, Caitlin Dickerson, speaks with one of its workers.
sentences.zh: 我的同事凯特琳·迪克森采访了该厂的一名工人。

sentences.en: It's Monday, May 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月4日，星期一。

sentences.en: As an immigration reporter, as soon as I hear that COVID-19 is starting to spread across the country, I start thinking about who are the most vulnerable people in this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 作为一名移民报道记者，当我听说新冠疫情开始在全国蔓延时，我立刻开始思考，在这场大流行中，谁是最脆弱的群体。

sentences.en: And right away, meat and poultry plants come to mind.
sentences.zh: 我马上就想到了肉类和禽类加工厂。

sentences.en: Because these facilities tend to be staffed by immigrants.
sentences.zh: 因为这些工厂的员工往往是移民。

sentences.en: There's going to be a lot of pressure on workers to show up for work because they've been deemed essential by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 工人们将面临巨大的压力去上班，因为他们被联邦政府认定为必要工作人员。

sentences.en: And because of the nature of the work.
sentences.zh: 而且由于工作的性质。

sentences.en: The facilities are massive.
sentences.zh: 这些设施规模巨大。

sentences.en: And often you have thousands of people working at a single time.
sentences.zh: 而且通常有成千上万的人同时在工作。

sentences.en: And they literally stand shoulder to shoulder.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上是肩并肩站着。

sentences.en: They're touching all the time.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在接触。

sentences.en: Are you there?
sentences.zh: 你在听吗？

sentences.en: Oh, shoot.
sentences.zh: 噢，糟糕。

sentences.en: You just dropped out.
sentences.zh: 信号断了。

sentences.en: Something happened.
sentences.zh: 出什么事了。

sentences.en: So I'm put in touch with a woman named Achute Dang.
sentences.zh: 所以我联系上了一位名叫阿楚特·当的女士。

sentences.en: We did it.
sentences.zh: 我们成功了。

sentences.en: Yes, we did.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们成功了。

sentences.en: Just to start out, Achute, can you just kind of introduce yourself and tell us what work you do?
sentences.zh: 阿楚特，首先请你简单介绍一下自己，并告诉我们你从事什么工作？

sentences.en: So my name is Achute Dang.
sentences.zh: 我叫阿楚特·当。

sentences.en: I work with Smithfield.
sentences.zh: 我在史密斯菲尔德工作。

sentences.en: We produce pork.
sentences.zh: 我们生产猪肉。

sentences.en: Achute is a shift lead at the
sentences.zh: 阿楚特是南达科他州苏福尔斯市

sentences.en: Smithfield pork plant in Sioux Falls, South Dakota.
sentences.zh: 史密斯菲尔德猪肉加工厂的一名轮班主管。

sentences.en: And I am a lead person for one department, eight floor conversion.
sentences.zh: 我是八楼转换部门的负责人。

sentences.en: She works in the conversion department, deboning and processing all different cuts of pork.
sentences.zh: 她在转换部门工作，负责对各种猪肉部位进行去骨和加工。

sentences.en: She's 35 and she's a single mom of three boys.
sentences.zh: 她今年35岁，是三个男孩的单亲妈妈。

sentences.en: Give me a second, okay?
sentences.zh: 等我一下，好吗？

sentences.en: My son just come in.
sentences.zh: 我儿子刚进来。

sentences.en: Give me a second.
sentences.zh: 等我一下。

sentences.en: Who are trying to get their homework done while we talk.
sentences.zh: 他们想在我们谈话时把作业写完。

sentences.en: Sorry, I'm back.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我回来了。

sentences.en: You're back.
sentences.zh: 你回来了。

sentences.en: You're back.
sentences.zh: 你回来了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So how did you come to work at Smithfield?
sentences.zh: 那么你是怎么来到史密斯菲尔德工作的呢？

sentences.en: Do you want me to go from South Sudan to Ethiopia to Kenya and to America?
sentences.zh: 你是想让我从南苏丹讲到埃塞俄比亚，再到肯尼亚，最后到美国吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So yes, I was born in South Sudan.
sentences.zh: 好的，我出生在南苏丹。

sentences.en: But then when I was six years old, we had a terrorist attack in the village.
sentences.zh: 但在我六岁时，村里发生了恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: Achute was born in Sudan and she became an orphan when she was six years old during the country's civil war.
sentences.zh: 阿楚特出生在苏丹，在六岁那年国家内战期间成了孤儿。

sentences.en: And we walked to Kenya.
sentences.zh: 我们步行去了肯尼亚。

sentences.en: And that was in 1990, in 1991 still.
sentences.zh: 那是1990年，或者还是1991年。

sentences.en: She grew up in refugee camps in Ethiopia and Kenya, where life was really hard.
sentences.zh: 她在埃塞俄比亚和肯尼亚的难民营中长大，生活非常艰苦。

sentences.en: They created the school, but pretty much people go and sit under the tree because there was no building or classroom or anything like that in the beginning.
sentences.zh: 他们建了学校，但起初因为没有建筑、教室之类的设施，大家基本上都是坐在树下上课。

sentences.en: Her school was a shady spot beneath a large tree where children wrote their English lessons with sticks in the dirt.
sentences.zh: 她的学校是大树下一块阴凉的地方，孩子们用棍子在泥地上写英语课文。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It seemed like it was normal at the time because we didn't have no any other choice.
sentences.zh: 当时觉得这很正常，因为我们别无选择。

sentences.en: She often went days without having food or fresh water.
sentences.zh: 她经常好几天没有食物或新鲜饮用水。

sentences.en: A lot of her friends died.
sentences.zh: 她的很多朋友都死了。

sentences.en: She didn't know if she was ever going to leave.
sentences.zh: 她不知道自己是否能离开那里。

sentences.en: So she took life one day at a time.
sentences.zh: 所以她只能过一天算一天。

sentences.en: I would say it was just surviving because you don't know what would happen tomorrow, you know?
sentences.zh: 我想那只是为了生存，因为你不知道明天会发生什么，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And then in the year 2000, her life changed completely.
sentences.zh: 然后在2000年，她的人生彻底改变了。

sentences.en: I got the news that I was, I'm going to get a second chance of life.
sentences.zh: 我得到消息说，我要获得第二次生命的机会了。

sentences.en: I'm going to go to the United States.
sentences.zh: 我要去美国了。

sentences.en: She was chosen for a program that relocated Sudanese orphans.
sentences.zh: 她被选中参加一个安置苏丹孤儿的项目。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: It was the happiest feeling for me.
sentences.zh: 那是我感到最幸福的时刻。

sentences.en: I could not believe.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: I didn't go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我整晚没睡。

sentences.en: The next day I went to school.
sentences.zh: 第二天我去了学校。

sentences.en: I told my friends.
sentences.zh: 我告诉了我的朋友们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: She moved to Kansas City and started a life in America.
sentences.zh: 她搬到了堪萨斯城，开始了在美国的生活。

sentences.en: She graduated high school and started community college.
sentences.zh: 她高中毕业，并开始上社区大学。

sentences.en: And then she starts working as a waitress and then in her late 20s doing private security.
sentences.zh: 后来她开始做服务员，二十多岁时做过私人保安。

sentences.en: And then how do you get to Sioux Falls, South Dakota?
sentences.zh: 那么你是怎么来到南达科他州苏福尔斯的呢？

sentences.en: You know, I always tell people I moved to Sioux Falls for a very stupid reason, thinking that I find a man.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我总是告诉别人，我搬到苏福尔斯的原因很蠢，以为能在那儿找到个男人。

sentences.en: So that was pretty much a reason right there.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是当时的主要原因。

sentences.en: So I moved in with my youngest son, father.
sentences.zh: 于是我带着小儿子的父亲搬了过去。

sentences.en: Then we broke up.
sentences.zh: 后来我们分手了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And how did you hear about the Smithfield factory for the first time?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么第一次听说史密斯菲尔德工厂的？

sentences.en: He actually told me about it because before I moved here, I told him I cannot go a month without a job because a lot of people are relying on me and most importantly, my kids.
sentences.zh: 其实是他告诉我的，因为在我搬来之前，我告诉他我不能一个月没有工作，因为很多人依赖我，最重要的是我的孩子们。

sentences.en: So, and that's when he told me, oh yeah, there is a company here, Smithfield.
sentences.zh: 所以，就在那时他告诉我，噢，这里有一家公司，叫史密斯菲尔德。

sentences.en: And when you were hearing about it, what were people saying?
sentences.zh: 当你听说它的时候，人们是怎么评价的？

sentences.en: It was good things.
sentences.zh: 都是好话。

sentences.en: Your start wages with Smithfield was $12.95.
sentences.zh: 你在史密斯菲尔德的起薪是每小时12.95美元。

sentences.en: That is a very good pay.
sentences.zh: 那是非常好的待遇。

sentences.en: They have health care, health insurance.
sentences.zh: 他们有医疗保健和医疗保险。

sentences.en: So a lot of people came to Sioux Falls because of Smithfield and what it was offering to people.
sentences.zh: 所以很多人因为史密斯菲尔德及其提供的福利而来到苏福尔斯。

sentences.en: I know a lot of Sudanese families came here because of
sentences.zh: 我知道很多苏丹家庭是因为

sentences.en: Smithfield.
sentences.zh: 史密斯菲尔德才来到这里的。

sentences.en: So when I went and put in my application right in there, they told me, okay, you start tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 所以我去递交了申请，他们当时就告诉我，好的，你明天就可以上班。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And I started as a wizard knife operator.
sentences.zh: 我最初是一名圆盘刀操作员。

sentences.en: And for someone who's never heard of
sentences.zh: 对于那些从未听说过

sentences.en: Smithfield or been to the plant, can you just walk through what exactly it is that you guys do there?
sentences.zh: 史密斯菲尔德或没去过工厂的人，你能简单介绍一下你们在那里具体做什么吗？

sentences.en: So Smithfield, we, um, receive live hogs, slaughter them, uh, cut them into, uh, pieces.
sentences.zh: 在史密斯菲尔德，我们接收活猪，屠宰它们，然后把它们切成块。

sentences.en: What I mean by that, by, uh, cutting off hams, legs, uh, we make bacon, uh, ham, even hot dogs, cheese hot dogs.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，切下火腿、猪腿，我们制作培根、火腿，甚至热狗、奶酪热狗。

sentences.en: We have them.
sentences.zh: 我们都有。

sentences.en: Those are the things we do at Smithfield.
sentences.zh: 这些就是我们在史密斯菲尔德做的事情。

sentences.en: So it's the, the entire pig that come alive, turn into so many things afterwards.
sentences.zh: 所以就是整头猪活着进来，之后变成各种各样的产品。

sentences.en: And what is a wizard knife?
sentences.zh: 什么是圆盘刀？

sentences.en: It's a circle knife that goes into this electric thing and you turn it off and on.
sentences.zh: 那是一种圆形刀片，装在电动装置上，你可以开关它。

sentences.en: And what is it used for?
sentences.zh: 它是用来做什么的？

sentences.en: They use wizard knife to trim off fat from the loin until it's pretty much all meat, just meat without fat.
sentences.zh: 人们用圆盘刀把里脊肉上的脂肪切掉，直到它几乎全是瘦肉，就是没有脂肪的肉。

sentences.en: So picture a massive factory floor with giant chunks of pork zooming by on a conveyor belt and a chute.
sentences.zh: 所以想象一下一个巨大的工厂车间，大块的猪肉在传送带上飞速移动，还有一个滑槽。

sentences.en: And the other wizard knife operators are responsible for shaving fat off of the meat as it zooms past them.
sentences.zh: 其他圆盘刀操作员负责在肉飞速经过时把脂肪削掉。

sentences.en: How many pigs are processed there every day?
sentences.zh: 那里每天处理多少头猪？

sentences.en: 10,000 or more pig.
sentences.zh: 一万头或更多。

sentences.en: That's huge.
sentences.zh: 那太庞大了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And they're responsible for four to 5% of all the pork that's produced in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们负责美国所有猪肉产量的4%到5%。

sentences.en: So when you first started, what did you think of it?
sentences.zh: 那么你刚开始的时候是怎么想的？

sentences.en: How did it go?
sentences.zh: 感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: What did I think of Smithfield?
sentences.zh: 我对史密斯菲尔德怎么看？

sentences.en: Hard work.
sentences.zh: 辛苦的工作。

sentences.en: Hard work is what I thought of it, but you're not really thinking of how hard it is.
sentences.zh: 我当时觉得这是辛苦的工作，但你其实并没有真正去想它有多辛苦。

sentences.en: You are thinking of money, you know, and, and everything that you, you know, when, once you get the paycheck, you are able to pay for the apartment.
sentences.zh: 你想到的是钱，你知道，当你拿到工资支票时，你就能支付房租。

sentences.en: You are able to put foods on the table.
sentences.zh: 你就能让家里有饭吃。

sentences.en: These were the thing that I was thinking.
sentences.zh: 这些就是我当时想的事情。

sentences.en: And what was it like for you physically in the beginning, starting out?
sentences.zh: 刚开始的时候，你的身体感觉如何？

sentences.en: Once you start doing something for the first time, something that you never done, your muscle is going to reject it.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次开始做某事，做你从未做过的事情时，你的肌肉会产生排斥。

sentences.en: Your body is going to reject it.
sentences.zh: 你的身体会产生排斥。

sentences.en: So I was always sore.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是感到酸痛。

sentences.en: I was always, my wrist was sore.
sentences.zh: 我总是手腕酸痛。

sentences.en: My arm, you know, when numb.
sentences.zh: 我的手臂，你知道，麻木了。

sentences.en: So after work, I would come home and put ice like on my shoulder or my wrist and then take ibuprofen.
sentences.zh: 所以下班后，我会回家在肩膀或手腕上敷冰袋，然后吃布洛芬。

sentences.en: Then I did that every night.
sentences.zh: 我每天晚上都这样做。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Until one day I went to first aid and I talked to the nurse and the nurse was very, very nice outgoing.
sentences.zh: 直到有一天我去了急救室，和护士谈了谈，那位护士非常非常友善、外向。

sentences.en: And she said, you know what?
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Let me give you this advice.
sentences.zh: 让我给你这个建议。

sentences.en: You know, this job is a hard work.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这份工作很辛苦。

sentences.en: It's a very hard work.
sentences.zh: 是非常辛苦的工作。

sentences.en: You've been doing this with a knife for, for a year now, and your wrist is hurting, your arm hurt, your shoulder hurt.
sentences.zh: 你用这把刀已经干了一年了，你的手腕在痛，手臂在痛，肩膀也在痛。

sentences.en: I would do one job for about a year, but after that, sign another job.
sentences.zh: 我通常会做一份工作大约一年，之后再换另一份。

sentences.en: That way you have a rotation in your body.
sentences.zh: 这样你的身体就能得到轮换。

sentences.en: So she takes this advice and over the next couple of years, she starts moving around the factory to different jobs.
sentences.zh: 于是她听从了这个建议，在接下来的几年里，她开始在工厂里轮换不同的岗位。

sentences.en: She eventually becomes a shift lead and she starts working a lot of overtime, usually
sentences.zh: 她最终成为了班组长，并开始经常加班，通常

sentences.en: 11 to 12 hours a day, six days a week, but it really pays off.
sentences.zh: 每天工作11到12个小时，每周六天，但这确实很有回报。

sentences.en: She starts to feel comfortable financially.
sentences.zh: 她的经济状况开始变得宽裕。

sentences.en: I get paid $18.70 an hour.
sentences.zh: 我的时薪是18.70美元。

sentences.en: What does that higher hourly wage meant for your life?
sentences.zh: 更高的时薪对你的生活意味着什么？

sentences.en: My boys, all three of them, I can give them what I never have, which is a better life at a young age.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们，三个孩子，我能给他们我从未拥有过的东西，那就是在年轻时过上更好的生活。

sentences.en: Last year, I took them to Disney World.
sentences.zh: 去年，我带他们去了迪士尼世界。

sentences.en: That's just something that when I went there, I cried, but it was a tears of happiness.
sentences.zh: 那是我去的时候，我哭了，但那是幸福的泪水。

sentences.en: I'm bringing my kids.
sentences.zh: 我带着我的孩子们。

sentences.en: I am American by papers.
sentences.zh: 从证件上来说我是美国人。

sentences.en: I bring my kids here.
sentences.zh: 我把我的孩子们带到这里。

sentences.en: And that was something I did.
sentences.zh: 那是我想做的事情。

sentences.en: I was so proud of myself.
sentences.zh: 我为自己感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: Between the new salary she's making and the overtime that she's working, she's able to move into a bigger apartment with her sons.
sentences.zh: 凭借新的工资和加班费，她得以和儿子们搬进了一套更大的公寓。

sentences.en: And she's also supporting five family members who are still living in Africa.
sentences.zh: 她还在资助远在非洲的五位家人。

sentences.en: So this job offered me to take care for everybody else, not just my boys, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以这份工作让我能够照顾其他人，不仅仅是我的孩子们，你明白吗？

sentences.en: So you're basically supporting nine people on your salary from
sentences.zh: 所以你基本上是用你在史密斯菲尔德的工资

sentences.en: Smithfield.
sentences.zh: 养活了九个人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that's why I pick up over time, regardless of me being tired.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么我即使很累也要加班。

sentences.en: Every morning when I go to work, I put everything that the company offered me in order to make sure this food that I'm making doesn't have anything that can go and harm someone.
sentences.zh: 每天早上我去上班时，我都会倾尽全力，确保我制作的这些食物不会对任何人造成伤害。

sentences.en: Because, you know, this food is going to families, it's going to children, it's going to mothers, it's going to fathers, uncles, aunts, everyone around the world.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，这些食物是给家庭的，是给孩子、母亲、父亲、叔叔、阿姨，给全世界每个人的。

sentences.en: Working at the meat factory, I'm making food for people around the world.
sentences.zh: 在肉类工厂工作，我是在为全世界的人制作食物。

sentences.en: I think of that every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在想这件事。

sentences.en: It sounds like you take a lot of pride in your job.
sentences.zh: 听起来你对自己的工作感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: Yes, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很自豪。

sentences.en: Do you remember the first time you heard about the coronavirus?
sentences.zh: 你还记得第一次听说新冠病毒是什么时候吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I would say there was sometime in January, February.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想大概是在一月或二月的时候。

sentences.en: We're just talking about it.
sentences.zh: 我们当时只是在谈论它。

sentences.en: It's kind of like it's something that happened in China and it's going to stay in China.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是发生在遥远中国的事情，应该会留在那里。

sentences.en: Then come the beginning of March, it was Seattle.
sentences.zh: 然后到了三月初，西雅图出现了病例。

sentences.en: And then the next morning I went to work and now everybody at work is talking about it.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上我去上班，现在工作场所的每个人都在谈论它。

sentences.en: But it's still most of us as refugees, immigrants, it's like, it's probably, you know, people are maybe just being extra about it right now.
sentences.zh: 但我们大多数作为难民或移民的人，还是觉得，可能大家只是对此反应过度了。

sentences.en: Maybe it's not that bad.
sentences.zh: 也许没那么严重。

sentences.en: Why do you think you reacted that way?
sentences.zh: 你为什么会那样想？

sentences.en: For me personally, I'm like, okay, if it become to affect, I'm like, I've been through so much.
sentences.zh: 对我个人而言，我觉得，好吧，如果它真的影响到我，我想，我经历过那么多风浪。

sentences.en: If this is just like a virus, you're talking to someone who had malaria.
sentences.zh: 如果这只是像病毒一样，你是在和一个得过疟疾的人说话。

sentences.en: You know, I survived that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我挺过来了。

sentences.en: So I was like, okay, if it's like, if it's going to be like malaria, I can go through it.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，好吧，如果它像疟疾一样，我能扛过去。

sentences.en: It's just going to be like any other thing that I've been through.
sentences.zh: 它只会像我经历过的任何其他事情一样。

sentences.en: But then on Saturday, March 21st, things start to change at Smithfield.
sentences.zh: 但到了3月21日星期六，史密斯菲尔德的情况开始发生变化。

sentences.en: When I went to work that morning, I saw a lot of people with
sentences.zh: 那天早上我去上班时，看到很多人在

sentences.en: cleaning up the handrails, doors, bathroom doors with wipes.
sentences.zh: 用湿巾擦拭扶手、门和洗手间的门。

sentences.en: And I'm like, what's going on?
sentences.zh: 我心想，这是怎么了？

sentences.en: And one of the people told me, yeah, this thing is serious.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人告诉我，是的，这事很严重。

sentences.en: This thing is serious.
sentences.zh: 这事很严重。

sentences.en: But, you know, I'm thinking now, okay, 150 to 160 people in one shift.
sentences.zh: 但我当时想，好吧，一个班次有150到160人。

sentences.en: You sitting in the break room to where tables are very small, you have six people in one table.
sentences.zh: 你坐在休息室里，桌子非常小，一张桌子要挤六个人。

sentences.en: And then later that day, she gets an email.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，她收到了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: That time was when I received an email, a video from the CEO, Smithfield CEO.
sentences.zh: 那时我收到了一封邮件，是首席执行官，史密斯菲尔德首席执行官发来的视频。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Ken Sullivan, President and CEO of Smithfield Foods.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是肯·沙利文，史密斯菲尔德食品公司的总裁兼首席执行官。

sentences.en: I'd like to talk to you today about COVID-19 or coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 今天我想和大家谈谈COVID-19，也就是新冠病毒。

sentences.en: So I watched the video from the CEO about this virus is not coming from food.
sentences.zh: 我看了首席执行官关于这种病毒不会通过食物传播的视频。

sentences.en: According to the FDA and CDC, there's no evidence that COVID-19 can be transmitted by food.
sentences.zh: 根据美国食品药品监督管理局和疾控中心的说法，没有证据表明COVID-19可以通过食物传播。

sentences.en: And America need food.
sentences.zh: 而美国需要食物。

sentences.en: Every family need food.
sentences.zh: 每个家庭都需要食物。

sentences.en: We don't want people to struggle from hunger, let alone a virus.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望人们在忍受病毒的同时还要忍受饥饿。

sentences.en: American families.
sentences.zh: 美国家庭。

sentences.en: We feed millions of people every day, every single day.
sentences.zh: 我们每天都在喂养数百万人，每一天都是如此。

sentences.en: It's a business with no shortcuts and no days off.
sentences.zh: 这是一项没有捷径、没有休息日的业务。

sentences.en: Most of our team members work side by side on production lines in our facilities.
sentences.zh: 我们的大多数团队成员在工厂的生产线上并肩工作。

sentences.en: We can't stay home.
sentences.zh: 我们不能待在家里。

sentences.en: We can't telecommute.
sentences.zh: 我们不能远程办公。

sentences.en: Food, after all, does not get made on the internet.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，食物不是在互联网上制造出来的。

sentences.en: So our company is not going to get shut down.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的公司不会关闭。

sentences.en: We're here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里。

sentences.en: We're always here.
sentences.zh: 我们一直都在这里。

sentences.en: We're a food company.
sentences.zh: 我们是一家食品公司。

sentences.en: And despite COVID-19, indeed, because of it, we're working around the clock to do what we do best, and that's deliver good food responsibly.
sentences.zh: 尽管有COVID-19，事实上正是因为有了它，我们正在全天候工作，做我们最擅长的事情，那就是负责任地提供优质食品。

sentences.en: How did it feel to you to have your job deemed essential in the middle of a pandemic when people all over the country are panicking?
sentences.zh: 当全国人民都在恐慌时，你的工作被认定为“必要岗位”，你对此有何感想？

sentences.en: You know, your work is deemed fundamental to keeping the country going.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你的工作被认为对维持国家运转至关重要。

sentences.en: At one point, I was negative about it.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，我对此感到消极。

sentences.en: At one point, I was like, wow, do that mean my life don't matter?
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，我想，哇，这是否意味着我的生命不重要？

sentences.en: And here I am putting my life at risk coming to work because people around the world need food.
sentences.zh: 我冒着生命危险来上班，因为全世界的人都需要食物。

sentences.en: But I said, okay, I'm just going to have to stay positive.
sentences.zh: 但我对自己说，好吧，我必须保持积极。

sentences.en: And people, if people need food, and I'm able to do that for them, then I'm just going to put my life to God to protect me and not get sick.
sentences.zh: 如果人们需要食物，而我有能力为他们提供，那么我就把我的生命交给上帝来保护我，不让我生病。

sentences.en: Did you ever consider just staying home from work and not going in?
sentences.zh: 你有没有考虑过干脆待在家里不去上班？

sentences.en: To be honest, I did not.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我没有。

sentences.en: I was just thinking of, no, I need this job.
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，不，我需要这份工作。

sentences.en: I need to keep working so I can support my family.
sentences.zh: 我需要继续工作来养活我的家人。

sentences.en: And it's, yeah, thinking about it now, it's like, it hurts.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，这让人心痛。

sentences.en: It hurts that you, you didn't think about yourself.
sentences.zh: 心痛的是，你根本没有为自己考虑过。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 解锁《纽约时报》应用程序。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果不用信用卡就能免费试用《时报》一个月呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，第一个月免费。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: By the end of March, hospitals across the country are being overrun by
sentences.zh: 到三月底，全国各地的医院都被

sentences.en: COVID patients.
sentences.zh: 新冠患者挤满了。

sentences.en: Governors start shutting down businesses and ordering people to shelter in their homes.
sentences.zh: 州长们开始关闭企业，并下令人们居家避疫。

sentences.en: But in South Dakota, there are still only a few COVID cases.
sentences.zh: 但在南达科他州，新冠病例仍然很少。

sentences.en: And a chute is still going to work until Saturday, March 28th.
sentences.zh: 而阿舒特一直工作到3月28日星期六。

sentences.en: Now, Saturday, my superintendents came up around, I would say at about three o'clock and he said, okay, I want to have a meeting.
sentences.zh: 周六，我的主管大约在三点钟左右过来，他说，好吧，我想开个会。

sentences.en: They asked me if I have any fever, cough, any, you know, shortness of breath.
sentences.zh: 他们问我是否有发烧、咳嗽，或者任何呼吸急促的症状。

sentences.en: And I say, no, I'm doing, I'm doing good.
sentences.zh: 我说没有，我感觉很好。

sentences.en: And he said, one of the machine operator tested positive.
sentences.zh: 他说，其中一名机器操作员检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: I say, what?
sentences.zh: 我说，什么？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That person, I worked with her that morning for like, I would say about 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 那个人，我那天早上和她一起工作了大约15分钟。

sentences.en: They said, okay, well, you got to go home because you had close contact with.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好吧，你得回家，因为你和她有过密切接触。

sentences.en: And I'm like, really?
sentences.zh: 我心想，真的吗？

sentences.en: You got, you know, I didn't say it out loud, but I'm thinking they're being silly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我没说出口，但我心里觉得他们太傻了。

sentences.en: And that's when they told me you're going to be under quarantine for the next 14 days, but I'm still going to get paid 40 hours.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他们告诉我，你接下来的14天要被隔离，但我仍然会拿到40小时的工资。

sentences.en: Is that enough for me?
sentences.zh: 这对我有用吗？

sentences.en: It's not enough for me as a person who do overtime.
sentences.zh: 对于一个靠加班生活的人来说，这根本不够。

sentences.en: Overtime is like 500 extra, $500.
sentences.zh: 加班费大约是500美元，额外500美元。

sentences.en: That for me, it covered a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那能解决很多问题。

sentences.en: What do I do?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么办？

sentences.en: I can't go and get another job.
sentences.zh: 我不能去换另一份工作。

sentences.en: But at that time, I was told it's just two weeks.
sentences.zh: 但当时他们告诉我只需要两周。

sentences.en: So I'm like, okay, two weeks, I, you know, I'll be okay.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，好吧，两周，我会没事的。

sentences.en: It's still going to drop me back one step backward, but I'll be okay.
sentences.zh: 虽然这还是会让我倒退一步，但我会挺过去的。

sentences.en: And then Monday night was when I got sick.
sentences.zh: 然后周一晚上我病倒了。

sentences.en: Monday night, I went to bed feeling okay.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，我睡觉时感觉还好。

sentences.en: I woke up about 2 a.m.
sentences.zh: 凌晨2点左右我醒了过来，

sentences.en: with this sharp pain on my body.
sentences.zh: 身上有种剧烈的疼痛。

sentences.en: It just felt like someone stabbed me.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像有人捅了我一刀。

sentences.en: So, you know, I went to the bathroom and I said, okay, maybe if I take a shower, a cold shower, it's going to be better.
sentences.zh: 于是我去了洗手间，心想，好吧，也许洗个冷水澡会好一点。

sentences.en: So I turned the water on and it just, when the water hit my body, it feel like a bunch of rocks was getting thrown on my body.
sentences.zh: 我打开水龙头，当水打在身上时，感觉就像有一堆石头砸在身上一样。

sentences.en: So I turned the water off.
sentences.zh: 所以我关掉了水。

sentences.en: I took the towel to dry myself and my skin.
sentences.zh: 我拿毛巾擦干身体，我的皮肤，

sentences.en: I just couldn't use the towel.
sentences.zh: 我根本没法用毛巾。

sentences.en: It just, my skin hurt.
sentences.zh: 我的皮肤太疼了。

sentences.en: So I'm like, okay, I'm freaking out.
sentences.zh: 我心想，好吧，我快崩溃了。

sentences.en: And then Thursday night, my body at this point is so exhausted.
sentences.zh: 然后到了周四晚上，我的身体已经精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: Even walking is like I'm pushing myself.
sentences.zh: 连走路都感觉像是在强迫自己。

sentences.en: I just felt like something heavy sit right on my cheSt. Now the fear really kicked in because now I'm having problem breathing.
sentences.zh: 我感觉胸口压着重物。现在恐惧真的袭来了，因为我开始呼吸困难。

sentences.en: I said, okay, if it's going to be better for me, I'm going to stay up, I don't want to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，如果我能好起来，我得保持清醒，我不想睡觉。

sentences.en: Because if I go to sleep, chances are going to be I'm not going to wake up.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我睡着了，很有可能就再也醒不过来了。

sentences.en: That's when I left my room.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我离开了卧室。

sentences.en: I came to the living room and just sat there because I said, okay, if I stay in my room and I die, I don't want my kids to find me dead in the room.
sentences.zh: 我来到客厅坐下，因为我想，如果我死在卧室里，我不希望孩子们发现我死在里面。

sentences.en: What was that like for you emotionally?
sentences.zh: 那对你来说在情感上意味着什么？

sentences.en: I mean, what's going through your mind?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你当时在想什么？

sentences.en: I went right back to my childhood, to everything that I've been through in life.
sentences.zh: 我立刻回想起了我的童年，回想起我一生中经历的一切。

sentences.en: And now my kids, if I die, my kids will go through the same thing I've been through.
sentences.zh: 现在如果我死了，我的孩子们也会经历我所经历过的一切。

sentences.en: The loneliness, you know, not having anybody to check into like a parent.
sentences.zh: 那种孤独，你知道，没有父母可以依靠。

sentences.en: I'm thinking, I'm thinking, I bring these kids to this world.
sentences.zh: 我在想，我在想，我把这些孩子带到了这个世界上。

sentences.en: I survive through everything that I went through.
sentences.zh: 我挺过了我所经历的一切。

sentences.en: I said, I haven't even had a chance to tell them they don't know their mom.
sentences.zh: 我说，我甚至还没来得及告诉他们，他们根本不了解他们的妈妈。

sentences.en: They don't know what their mom went through.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道他们的妈妈经历了什么。

sentences.en: All they know is that my mom is a workaholic.
sentences.zh: 他们只知道我的妈妈是个工作狂。

sentences.en: She would do anything to give us a better life.
sentences.zh: 她会不惜一切代价给我们更好的生活。

sentences.en: That's all they know.
sentences.zh: 他们只知道这些。

sentences.en: It's not a perfect world.
sentences.zh: 世界并不完美。

sentences.en: I'd make it perfect for them.
sentences.zh: 我会为他们创造一个完美的世界。

sentences.en: But if I die, this world is not perfect anymore.
sentences.zh: 但如果我死了，这个世界就不再完美了。

sentences.en: It sounds like a horrible, horrible night.
sentences.zh: 听起来那是个极其糟糕的夜晚。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: It was, it was one of the worst night ever.
sentences.zh: 确实，那是我经历过最糟糕的夜晚之一。

sentences.en: So while Lachute is at home sick with the coronavirus, the situation at Smithfield is evolving.
sentences.zh: 所以，当拉舒特（Lachute）在家因感染新冠病毒而病倒时，史密斯菲尔德（Smithfield）的情况正在恶化。

sentences.en: This Smithfield pork processing plant is now a coronavirus hotspot.
sentences.zh: 这家史密斯菲尔德猪肉加工厂现在成了新冠病毒的重灾区。

sentences.en: More and more of her colleagues are falling ill.
sentences.zh: 她的同事们接二连三地病倒了。

sentences.en: How many other cases do you hear about among your colleagues?
sentences.zh: 你听说你的同事中还有多少人感染了？

sentences.en: Oh, a lot, a lot, a lot.
sentences.zh: 哦，很多，非常多。

sentences.en: I think within the South Sudanese community alone, I think we have like at least 40 people that I know.
sentences.zh: 我想仅在南苏丹社区，我知道的至少就有40人感染。

sentences.en: But in my department, I was told that it went up to 80 in one department, 80 people.
sentences.zh: 但在我的部门，有人告诉我仅一个部门就有80人感染，80个人。

sentences.en: And how big is your department?
sentences.zh: 你们部门有多少人？

sentences.en: On a good day that people showed up, it's 155.
sentences.zh: 在人员到齐的好日子里，总共是155人。

sentences.en: The outbreak at that Sioux Falls plant is among the worst clusters of coronavirus in the country.
sentences.zh: 苏福尔斯（Sioux Falls）那家工厂的疫情是全国最严重的新冠病毒聚集性感染事件之一。

sentences.en: About 250 workers there tested positive for coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 那里约有250名工人新冠病毒检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: 350 workers tested positive for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 350名工人新冠病毒检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: And as the days pass, it keeps getting worse.
sentences.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，情况变得越来越糟。

sentences.en: The number of cases skyrockets, up to more than 400 Smithfield workers who are sick.
sentences.zh: 病例数量激增，史密斯菲尔德生病的工人已超过400人。

sentences.en: And the governor calls on the head of the company to stop production.
sentences.zh: 州长呼吁公司负责人停止生产。

sentences.en: One of the nation's largest food processors, Smithfield Foods, will close its pork processing plant in South Dakota for further cleaning.
sentences.zh: 全美最大的食品加工商之一，史密斯菲尔德食品公司，将关闭其位于南达科他州的猪肉加工厂进行深度清洁。

sentences.en: So on April 12th, the president of Smithfield announces he's going to close the plant indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 因此在4月12日，史密斯菲尔德总裁宣布将无限期关闭该工厂。

sentences.en: And all the workers are sent home.
sentences.zh: 所有工人都被送回家了。

sentences.en: This morning, there were fears the nation's food supply chain is at a breaking point after more than a dozen major meat processing plants have become COVID-19 hotspots.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，人们担心在十几家大型肉类加工厂成为新冠病毒重灾区后，国家的食品供应链正处于崩溃边缘。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, food processing plants across the country are getting hit hard with COVID.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，全国各地的食品加工厂都受到了新冠疫情的沉重打击。

sentences.en: Other major companies like Tyson start raising the alarm that they're having trouble producing and delivering food to the nation's grocery stores because of the virus.
sentences.zh: 泰森（Tyson）等其他大型公司开始发出警告，称由于病毒的影响，他们在生产和向全国杂货店运送食品方面遇到了困难。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, President Trump announced an executive order to compel meat processing plants to remain open.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，特朗普总统宣布了一项行政命令，强制肉类加工厂保持运营。

sentences.en: And last week, President Trump signs an executive order declaring meat and poultry plants
sentences.zh: 上周，特朗普总统签署了一项行政命令，宣布肉类和家禽加工厂

sentences.en: as part of the nation's critical infrastructure as a way to pressure the plants to keep producing food.
sentences.zh: 属于国家关键基础设施的一部分，以此向工厂施压，要求其继续生产食品。

sentences.en: In Sioux Falls, the plant is still closed.
sentences.zh: 在苏福尔斯，工厂仍然处于关闭状态。

sentences.en: Smithfield says it will continue to pay workers for 40 hours a week until they go back to work.
sentences.zh: 史密斯菲尔德表示，在工人复工前，将继续支付他们每周40小时的工资。

sentences.en: And it's speeding up plants to reopen the plant as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 并且正在加快进度，争取尽快重新开放工厂。

sentences.en: But that's also raised questions about whether it can do so safely.
sentences.zh: 但这同时也引发了人们对工厂能否安全复工的质疑。

sentences.en: How are you feeling now physically?
sentences.zh: 你现在的身体感觉如何？

sentences.en: Physically, I feel good.
sentences.zh: 身体上，我感觉不错。

sentences.en: I'm still having a little bit of headache.
sentences.zh: 还是有一点点头痛。

sentences.en: But, you know, that's like almost an everyday thing when you are a mom and, you know, so I'm not freaking out over it.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，作为一名母亲，这几乎是每天都会发生的事，所以我并没有因此感到惊慌。

sentences.en: But my fever this morning is still at 100.
sentences.zh: 但我今天早上的体温仍然在100华氏度（约37.8摄氏度）。

sentences.en: And I have no idea why.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to get it down to like 99 at least before I call my doctor to go for a check-in.
sentences.zh: 我只是想在给医生打电话复诊前，至少把它降到99度左右。

sentences.en: But I cannot afford to stay home for a long time.
sentences.zh: 但我负担不起长期呆在家里的费用。

sentences.en: I would give myself a month.
sentences.zh: 我给自己设定了一个月的期限。

sentences.en: And if it goes after four weeks, no, it wouldn't be good for me at all.
sentences.zh: 如果超过四周还没好，不，那对我来说一点也不好。

sentences.en: It sounds like as soon as you start feeling better, your focus goes from your health back to your finances.
sentences.zh: 听起来你一旦感觉好转，注意力就从健康又转回到了经济问题上。

sentences.en: Yes, that is correct.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So now my focus is to try to take care of myself as possible to where when this company opened back up, then I'm ready to go.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我的重点是尽可能照顾好自己，这样当公司重新开业时，我就能准备好去上班了。

sentences.en: So that's where my focus is.
sentences.zh: 这就是我关注的重点。

sentences.en: Achute, thank you so much for talking to us about your experience.
sentences.zh: 阿舒特（Achute），非常感谢你与我们分享你的经历。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: And thank you very much for at least giving me the voice.
sentences.zh: 也非常感谢你至少给了我发声的机会。

sentences.en: A lot of people don't understand the living of the refugee camp.
sentences.zh: 很多人并不了解难民营的生活。

sentences.en: I don't take anything for granted because of what I've been through.
sentences.zh: 因为我所经历的一切，我不会把任何事情视为理所当然。

sentences.en: It's like, and because of what I see happening to other kids, that did not make it.
sentences.zh: 这就像，因为我看到其他没能活下来的孩子们所遭遇的一切。

sentences.en: But I'm pretty sure they are looking over me.
sentences.zh: 但我很确定他们在守护着我。

sentences.en: They are watching me.
sentences.zh: 他们在看着我。

sentences.en: And I'm going to make them proud.
sentences.zh: 我会让他们感到骄傲的。

sentences.en: On Friday, federal officials said they were investigating the conditions at the South Dakota
sentences.zh: 周五，联邦官员表示他们正在调查南达科他州

sentences.en: Smithfield plant that may have contributed to the outbreak.
sentences.zh: 史密斯菲尔德工厂的情况，这些情况可能导致了疫情的爆发。

sentences.en: So far, more than 1,000 infections and two deaths have been linked to the plant.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，已有超过1000例感染和两起死亡病例与该工厂有关。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, it is scheduled to partially reopen later today.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，它仍计划于今天晚些时候部分重新开放。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Friday, the Food and Drug Administration granted emergency approval to the antiviral drug
sentences.zh: 周五，美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）授予了抗病毒药物

sentences.en: remdesivir, making it the first government-sanctioned treatment for those with COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 瑞德西韦（remdesivir）紧急批准，使其成为首个获得政府批准用于治疗新冠肺炎的药物。

sentences.en: Now that your company has this emergency use authorization, how quickly will the drug get to those people who need it?
sentences.zh: 既然你们公司已经获得了这项紧急使用授权，药物多快能送到那些需要的人手中？

sentences.en: We are grateful and really humbled that everything has moved so quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激，也深感荣幸一切进展得如此迅速。

sentences.en: In an interview on Sunday with CBS, the CEO of the drug's manufacturer, Gilead, said he was working with federal officials to ensure that the first shipments of the drug
sentences.zh: 在周日接受哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）采访时，该药物制造商吉利德（Gilead）的首席执行官表示，他正在与联邦官员合作，确保首批药物

sentences.en: reach America's hardest-hit communities and hospitals.
sentences.zh: 能够送达美国受灾最严重的社区和医院。

sentences.en: And, Margaret, we intend to get that to patients in the early part of this next week, beginning to work with the government, which will determine which cities are most vulnerable
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特（Margaret），我们打算在下周初将药物送到患者手中，并开始与政府合作，由政府确定哪些城市最脆弱，

sentences.en: and where the patients are that need this medicine.
sentences.zh: 以及需要这种药物的患者在哪里。

sentences.en: And we're going to form a consortium with our seven Northeast partner states, which buy about $5 billion worth of equipment and supplies.
sentences.zh: 我们将与我们的七个东北部伙伴州组成一个联盟，这些州购买价值约50亿美元的设备和物资。

sentences.en: That will then increase our market power when we're buying.
sentences.zh: 这将增强我们在采购时的市场议价能力。

sentences.en: Seven states said they would begin jointly purchasing medical equipment, from gloves to ventilators, to avoid competing with one another.
sentences.zh: 七个州表示，他们将开始联合采购医疗设备，从手套到呼吸机，以避免彼此竞争。

sentences.en: And because the federal stockpile of such equipment is running out.
sentences.zh: 因为联邦政府的此类设备库存正在耗尽。

sentences.en: So this consortium, I think, will help us get the equipment and get it at a better price.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，这个联盟将帮助我们获得设备，并以更优惠的价格买到。

sentences.en: The consortium involves New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island.
sentences.zh: 该联盟包括纽约州、新泽西州、康涅狄格州、宾夕法尼亚州、特拉华州、马萨诸塞州和罗德岛州。

sentences.en: As of Sunday, there were nearly 68,000 deaths from the coronavirus in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 截至周日，美国已有近68000人死于新冠病毒，

sentences.en: and nearly 246,000 worldwide.
sentences.zh: 全球死亡人数近246000人。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》（Metro）节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig）将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在你获取播客的任何平台收听。

sentences.en: Let's see you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。
